description: Full public profile of one worker or business: about, services, service area, how to contact them (phone, WhatsApp, email, website, social pages), payment methods, rating and a link to the page. Give the slug from search_businesses.

language.description: Language of the names and links in the answer (default es).

slug.description: The profile slug, exactly as returned by search_businesses or top_rated (for example "carlos-jimenez").
